info.name: Foundry Academy LMS API
info.description:
Canonical API contract for the Foundry Academy LMS.

Authentication uses the HTTP-only `token` cookie. In Postman, run Login or
Verify email OTP first and allow Postman's cookie jar to retain the cookie.
Admin and super-admin requests require an account with the matching backend
permission.

GENERATED FILE: edit docs/api/openapi.yaml, then run npm run api:postman.

Authentication uses the Postman cookie jar. Login or OTP verification first; never paste the HTTP-only JWT into collection variables.

Access labels: [PUBLIC] no login; [SIGNED IN] any authenticated account subject to ownership; [STUDENT] learner operation; [ADMIN + SUPER ADMIN] both administrative roles; [SUPER ADMIN ONLY] regular admins are rejected.

A Course is the real-world program a student browses and enrolls in — content, pricing, and certificate policy are fixed here and shared by every Intake underneath it. See the 2026-08-30 course-to-program-intake rename plan.

item.name: [ADMIN + SUPER ADMIN] Create a course

body.raw:
{
  "categoryId": "{{categoryId}}",
  "slug": "ai-ml-ignition",
  "title": "AI/ML Ignition Program",
  "summary": "Learn practical AI and machine-learning foundations.",
  "description": "A practical guided program for engineers beginning applied AI and machine learning.",
  "level": "BEGINNER",
  "durationValue": 4,
  "durationUnit": "WEEK",
  "price": 0,
  "highlights": [
    "Requests",
    "Environments",
    "Tests"
  ],
  "skills": [
    "Postman",
    "HTTP",
    "API Testing"
  ],
  "prerequisites": [
    "Basic web knowledge"
  ],
  "thumbnailUrl": null,
  "sortOrder": 0,
  "intakeCodePrefix": "AI-ML-IGNITION",
  "certificateEnabled": true,
  "discountAmount": 0

request.description:

item.name: 07 Session Library
[ADMIN + SUPER ADMIN] List Session Library resources

query.description: Return sessions with a tag containing this text (case-insensitive partial match).
Return Ready library sessions with no active or retired relationship to this intake. Retired relationships are restored from curriculum history instead of the picker.

request.description:
Access: ADMIN + SUPER ADMIN

Admin/session-library permission required. Supports lifecycle, search, pagination, and intake-attachability filters. Every session is reusable across intakes. The response includes a `summary` object ({ all, ready, draft, archive }) counting sessions by status under the current search/tag filters, independent of the status filter itself — used to drive status filter pills.

item.name: [ADMIN + SUPER ADMIN] Update enrollment or payment status

request.description:
Access: ADMIN + SUPER ADMIN

Admin/enrollment-management permission required. Active may move to Completed or Cancelled. Cancelled paid/admin enrollment may return to Active; cancelled self-enrollment is reactivated only by its student enrollment endpoint. Completed is terminal and cannot be reopened or cancelled through this operation. Status writes are serialized with student completion mutations.

Operation ID: updateEnrollment

item.name: [ADMIN + SUPER ADMIN] Record the remaining half-payment for a partially paid enrollment

request.description:
Access: ADMIN + SUPER ADMIN

Admin/enrollment-management permission required. Only a PARTIAL enrollment can be completed this way — records a TOP_UP payment ledger entry for the other half of the course price (never discounted, unlike a one-time full payment) and moves paymentStatus to COMPLETED.

Operation ID: completeEnrollmentPayment

item.name: [STUDENT] Self-enroll in a free intake

request.description:
Access: STUDENT

Student-only. The intake and its parent category must be published, enrollment must be Open, and the Free Learning intake must contain at least one active curriculum session. Repeating the request for a live enrollment is idempotent. If the student's direct enrollment was cancelled, the same enrollment is reactivated so its progress and history remain attached; reactivation is intentionally not an admin operation.

Operation ID: selfEnrollFreeCourse

item.name: 10 Enrollment Requests
[STUDENT] Request enrollment in a paid course

request.description:
Access: STUDENT

The missing link between a PAID course's public "Enroll" button and the admin-mediated payment process. Filed against the course's current open (or next) intake; notifies every admin by email with a deep link. Does not create an Enrollment by itself — an admin converts the request via POST /enrollment-requests/{id}/enroll.

Operation ID: createEnrollmentRequest

item.name: [ADMIN + SUPER ADMIN] List enrollment requests filed against this intake

request.description:
Access: ADMIN + SUPER ADMIN

Admin/enrollment-management permission required. Returns a `summary` object counting requests by status ({ all, PENDING, CONTACTED, ENROLLED, DECLINED }) alongside the offset-paginated page.

Operation ID: listIntakeEnrollmentRequests

item.name: [ADMIN + SUPER ADMIN] Mark an enrollment request Contacted or Declined, or reopen a Declined one

request.description:
Access: ADMIN + SUPER ADMIN

Allowed transitions: PENDING -> CONTACTED | DECLINED, CONTACTED -> DECLINED, DECLINED -> PENDING (reopen, in place of forcing the student to resubmit). Enrolled is reached only through POST .../enroll, never through this endpoint.

Operation ID: updateEnrollmentRequestStatus

item.name: [ADMIN + SUPER ADMIN] Convert a request into a real enrollment

request.description:
Access: ADMIN + SUPER ADMIN

Records payment and creates the Enrollment through the same shared enroll mutation the direct search-and-enroll flow uses (POST /intakes/{intakeId}/enrollments) — not a second implementation of the enroll rules. Marks the request Enrolled and links it to the new enrollment.

Operation ID: enrollFromEnrollmentRequest
